newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Entertainment to start pilot.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Entertainment to start pilot.

text.p: Atlantic International Entertainment Ltd said Tuesday it signed a pilot agreement with British gaming company Casino Alive Ltd to demonstrate its internet gaming software in one Casino Alive's outlets.

Atlantic said the company could receive revenues of up to $5 million a year if the pilot, which runs from July 3 through August 2, is successful. The company said Casino Alive has 100 outlets in Asia.
Atlantic said in February it bought internet software developer EmiNet Domain for $2.02 million in cash and stock. The company's stock traded at 5 Tuesday afternoon, up 1-5/8.
